robarngrill01.name: Royal Oak Bar N Grill
robarngrill01.description:
A long bar stretches along the back wall showing a number of empty bottles and is riddled with stains lined with bar stools. The room is very dim lit by a few lights under the bar and some track lighting that could have been considered stylish before the building started to rot. 
To the west a small seating area can be seen. To the east a stairway leads up.

scenery.name: stairs
description: To the east an old oak stairway ascends up past a small archway.

scenery.name: long bar
description: The bar is ancient even by standards of a fossil. The surface is carved with numerous names and innuendoes and stained with countless marks from bottles and what looks like a poem is carved into the bar as well.

scenery.name: floor
description: The floor is a mix of dirt and peanut shells ground into a fine powder on heavy wooden planks.

scenery.name: carving
description:
Carved into the bars surface is a poem
 "As I went down the hill along the wall 
There was a gate I had leaned at for the view  
And had just turned from when I first saw you  
As you came up the hill. We met. But all  
We did that day was mingle great and small  
Footprints in summer dust as if we drew  
The figure of our being less than two  
But more than one as yet. Your parasol  
Pointed the decimal off with one deep thrust.  
And all the time we talked you seemed to see  
Something down there to smile at in the dust.  
(Oh, it was without prejudice to me!)  
Afterward I went past what you had passed  
Before we met and you what I had passed." - Robert Frost

scenery.name: bottles
description: The bottles line the back wall and appear to be empty and covered in dust.

scenery.name: lights
description: The lights across the ceiling are dim and flicker on occasion, from under the bar a steady blue light illuminates the bar stools.

scenery.name: bar stools
description: A number of bar stools made of stout wood line the bar along the wall.

scenery.name: a digital forum
description: A digital forum is here.

npcs.name: Rusty
description: Rusty is the owner of the Bar N Grill, an old and famous drinking establishment in the heart of Royal Oak.  He has bright red hair and seems to be amused by you looking at him. A shiney button on his shirt says WHITE%^"Ask me about Crafting"
npcs.room_description: Rusty the barkeep is standing here.

romainstwallgate.description:
A large wall fashioned of overturned cars, road signs, garbage, and twisted metal parts to the south to form a gate. To the north a few buildings can be seen down a broken asphalt road.
A weathered Savsoul door to the east leads back to Haven.

scenery.name: gate
description: The gate is made of a chain link fence covered with street signs and various bits of sheet metal.

scenery.name: wall
description: The wall is a pile of rusting metal parts consisting of mostly garbage and old car parts. There are signs that the wall has been repaired many times by piling more garbage where breaks occur.

scenery.name: bonfire
description: A small bonfire is here illuminating the gate, there appears to be fires outside the gate as well.

rogatesystem.name: Royal Oak Gate Controls
rogatesystem.description:
A large metal box has been ripped open showing a bank of lights and a terminal is visible from a small nook near the wall. This appears to be the control system for the electrified wall protecting the city of Royal Oak.
To the east the main gate of the wall can be seen.

rochargingstation01.description: The parking lot here has an assortment of power terminals for powering cars and devices. It has long since gone dark lacking the infrastructure to keep the lights running. The lot itself seems to be mostly clear of bodies, cars, and garbage suggesting someone is cleaning on a regular basis.

scenery.name: tires
description: No evidence of cars can be seen here, there are deep ruts that suggested heavy use of the lot in the past.

scenery.name: asphalt
description: The asphalt log is broken in many places but seems to be clear and ready to open and be used by a vehicle.

rochargingstation02.name: Royal Oak Charging Station
rochargingstation02.description: The charging station has some emergency lights powering the small area inside adding faintly to the daylight streaming in from the windows that line the wall near the ceiling. Along the wall a large rack of weapons can be seen. Tiny weapons up to massive weapons are lined up with small prices written in marker below each. There seems to be a careful order to everything in the shop in the arrangement of the items. Even the personal effects of the person living here are in a clean yet gritty order.

scenery.name: charging station
description: The station was once a center for car charging for motorists on the freeway.

scenery.name: asphalt
description: The parking lot outside appears to be well maintained and in good order.

scenery.name: emergency lights
description: The emergency lights give off a familiar security light glow illuminating the small space in the charging station with an effecient and delicate light.

scenery.name: window

scenery.name: weapons
description: You can find out more about what is available and the price with the list command.

scenery.name: personal
description: A small number of personal items are neatly arranged near the wall that suggest this is not only a shop but also a home.

smallwhiteshack.description: The small shack is littered with garbage and refuse. The walls appear to be slanting in slightly as the paint peels from them. The water damage does not appear to stop at just the walls but the floor as well.

scenery.name: garbage

scenery.name: walls

scenery.name: white

romainst01.name: South Royal Oak Main Street
romainst01.description: The center of main street shows a dusty asphalt road leading north and south. To the east a faded mist overlays destroyed buildings. A small building with a red cross lies to the west.

description: The ruins stretching to the east are shrouded in a strange mist evoking primal fears of the unknown.

scenery.name: ground
description: The faded road stretches to the north showing more of Royal Oak. To the south the road leads to a large impromptu wall.

scenery.name: medical
description: The building to the west appears to be a medical building.

medical-center-hub.name: Medical Center Hub
medical-center-hub.description:
The room is lit by a number of dull florescent lights hanging overhead showing a dirty floor and sagging water soaked plaster walls. What was once a bright center for healing appears to be slowly decaying with time. There is a sign on the west wall above a curtained door.
Use 'read sign' or 'look sign' to read the medical center sign.

scenery.name: light
description: The florescent lights flicker faintly illuminating the dirty room. They appear to run on the buildings main power supply.

scenery.name: floor
description: The floor is tiled with misplaced and broken tiles showing years of decay.

scenery.name: sign
description:
A small backlit sign on the wall. Use 'read sign' or 'look sign' to read it.
For injuries or purchases please step through the curtain.

scenery.name: wall
description: The plaster walls are chipped and threatening to fall as time has slowly destroyed them.

scenery.name: curtain
description: The parted curtains were once sterile white are now torn and threadbare showing an exit to the west.

npcs.name: Sue Rodgers
description: Sue Rodgers is a beautiful 6 foot tall blonde nurse. She works quietly as she goes about healing the sick.
